_meta.purpose: F-WF-05 CORE-WIRE-N8N SKELETON-wave overlay. Per-step x_secops_ng.core_body bindings layered onto the canonical content/playbooks/incident_management/playbook.cacao.json to produce the n8n mirror at examples/n8n/incident_management/playbook.cacao.json. The canonical CACAO source intentionally carries no core_body blocks yet; the n8n SKELETON example mirror diverges to demonstrate the wire-in shape ahead of the sibling Temporal and LangGraph CORE-WIRE cards. When those land and the canonical gets the core_body promoted upward, this overlay collapses to empty and the n8n mirror returns to byte-parity with the canonical.
binding_layout: action--...0006 submit 24h early warning -> incident_management.primitives.regulator_submission.resolve_destination(stage='early_warning') (fail-closed destination resolver; framework ships no default endpoint).
action--...0007 submit 72h notification -> incident_management.primitives.stage_clock.verdict_for_submission(stage='notification', ...) (three-stage NIS2 Article 23 clock arithmetic).
action--...0009 submit 1-month final report -> incident_management.primitives.regulator_submission.resolve_destination(stage='final_report') (fail-closed destination resolver).

Asymmetry between the three submit steps (two bind the destination resolver, one binds the clock verdict) is a deliberate SKELETON demonstration: every primitive group named on the wave card (stage-clock, classification, regulator-submission) is exercised somewhere in the workflow, with the operator wiring the second primitive per step at the n8n Code-node layer. Subsequent waves consolidate per-step bindings.

DSPy reach stays scoped to the free-text fields of the final report per content/playbooks/incident_management/primitives/signatures.py; regulated decisions (clock, classification, destination resolution) are deterministic code, not LM.
_meta.wave_seam_closure_condition: Closed by the F-WF-05 CORE-WIRE-TMPRL and CORE-WIRE-LG sibling cards. When both land, the canonical content/playbooks/incident_management/playbook.cacao.json gains the core_body blocks (a single source of truth for the three compile targets) and this overlay file is deleted in the same PR that lands the canonical promotion.
